title: December CPI Inflation Cools to 1.33%
summary: Retail inflation drops to 1.33% in December 2025 as Consumer Food Price Index (CFPI) enters negative territory (-2.71%).

blocks.title: 📰 7. 🏆 AWARDS, BOOKS, INDICES & RANKINGS
blocks.text: 🪝 December CPI Inflation Cools to 1.33%. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: India's headline CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) inflation cooled to **1.33% in December 2025**, driven by a sharp drop in food prices with CFPI food inflation printing at **-2.71%**.
**Urban vs Rural Headline**: Urban rose to 2.03%; Rural rose to 0.76%.
**Sectoral Rates**: Housing 2.86%, Education 3.32%, Health 3.43%, Fuel & Light 1.97%.
